starvation_root_cause: ROOT CAUSE (OBSERVED, n=13+13 skips): the R50/R51 corridor predicate counted EVERY live entity between player and target as a blocker. The dumps show the top blockers are non-absorbing, non-paying classes: in-flight projectile_air entities (0xbdf8/0x1be0/0x2950/0x9558/0xac64) and the bullet-TRANSPARENT 0xab94 wasp (n=4 piercing evidence, R50/R51). The player also never advanced in pass A (a single px value across all skips). The starvation is a PROTOCOL-PREDICATE defect in the MSX workstream, NOT an observer defect and NOT a runtime defect.
gate_fix: the corrected corridor predicate (blockers must absorb the bullet or register the payment) — TESTED in-game; it produced the +500 capture
pay_frame_law: OBSERVED (n=1 vs n=2 this round, consistent with the R48-R52 mid-window pays): the +500 paid at tail f1 (bullet-impact frame, victim still pre-hit) while the +1000s paid at tail f3/f4. The payout PRECEDES the victim's visible 0x5b0c registration by ~2 frames in every capture: the score accumulator pays on the internal damage event, not on the death state. The registration witness is the slot12@0xa0 pulse.
discriminator_status: OBSERVED (n=1 vs n=4): 21 union-net offsets separate the +500 pay-frame vector from all four banked +1000 vectors with zero overlap — but the +500 capture is a different entity/state class (one-hit 0x1e38 kill vs wound-recovery connects), so identity words dominate. The +500 class has exactly ONE pay-frame capture; the discriminator stays PENDING until n>=2 +500 captures exist. What IS established: the +500 capture exists at pay-frame granularity, the +500 class is NOT confined to surviving 0x42bc connects (R66: a one-bullet kill paid +500), and the +1000 class reproduced (2 more).
